name: zvideo_capture_surface_to_image
description: zVideo_buff_CaptureSurfaceToImage captures a selected 16-bit surface state into an owned zVid image, preserving dimensions and row pitch handling.
known_limits: tier S verification is blocked by current zVideo capture source-shape/codegen drift: local VC5 target zvideo_capture_surface_to_image fails 285 unmasked byte mismatches after 40 relocation-masked bytes and 9 trimmed NOP bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; vc5_o2_ob1_md_facs and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs fail with the same mismatch count, while vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs does not compile because the MFC _AFXDLL build requires /MD.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6e80 locks the display-mode surface, selects sw/primary/display surface state for source selectors 0, 1, and 2, creates a zVid image, sets width and height, allocates 16-bit pixel storage, marks the image as owning pixels, copies either contiguous pixels or each pitched row, unlocks the display-mode surface on successful capture paths, and returns the image.

The native smoke exercises selector 2 with a pitch wider than width and verifies image dimensions, pixel count, owned-pixel flag, allocated pixel storage, row-wise copy, and release through zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault.
